verdict.rationale: Jitsu's core design delivers your event data into warehouses and storage you own (Postgres, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, S3, GCS), with profiles also stored in your warehouse, so the data is never held only inside Jitsu. It is 100% open source and self-hostable, uses a Segment-compatible API that eases switching, and workspace configuration is reachable through a Management API and CLI. A community user confirms collecting data straight into BigQuery. Missing for 10: an explicit export/offboarding feature or doc for workspace configuration and data held inside Jitsu, documented open file formats for storage destinations, and independent hands-on evidence of migrating away.
